notes.title: Update Changelog + Notes/Quesitons
notes.notes:
The updates today (11/26/2017) did these things:
Added 200 More meters of land to explore
Added a Small Bandit Camp
Added more Hanging Men
Added Medical Items
Added More loots
Changed Wolf locations
Fixed Building Leaving
Changed Main Menu Slightly 
Added Bullets to Cars
Added New Book: Fab
Added two in-progress Wells
Added Eletric Fences
Added Explosive Barrels

Coming at somepoint stuff:
----------------------------------------
How the inventory works
Trading Cards
More World

Notes:
The wolfs and wells are still being tested so they may not work well but they are there. 

You can submit new books to me to put into the game via Twitter or the Support Email if you can find those.

If you would like some help in the game ask around the community, I am sure somebodys knows what's going on.

Any questions, comments, or bugs you can always post and I will get to you as fast as I can with an answer.



Links:
Follow my twitter if you just want little updates or want to start a conversation, ask a question publicly and quickly, or just follow a dev.
Twitter

Add me for questions, or to play a game with me. Something along those lines.
Georges Steam Page

A Steam group thingy I have.
Obscure Studios Steam Group

My first and terrible game that I made out of passion for no one but myself.

News Letter of Doom: Week 5: New Schedule, Update, Challenge, Obscure Realm?
notes.notes:
(Links at the bottom of the page)
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27870273/c5d144f15f08c7e1ae489d0970766d616985685e.png
The New Schedule: Whats happening?
It's been a rusty 2 weeks, a broken update, weird add-ons
that were more or less just a distraction, sorry.
Now there is, for now, a permanent schedule for how updates
and newsletters will go out. 
Every Sunday the 'News Letter of Doom' will come out for everyone to read at 10am Eastern Standard.
 Then, if I have anything else to say then a 'Part 2' will also be released. Every Saturday is
the day I will be writing the 'News Letter of Doom' so
if you have anything you would like to say just shoot
me a message on Steam. 
Updates will come out every week no matter how big or 
small. At the beginning of the week at the very bottom of
the newsletter will show everything that is planned to come
out and at the end of the week the 'Change-Log' and update will
show exactly what does end up coming out.
Also for anyone who did not know we have a Steam Group for
Obscure Studios, this will also be regularly updated.

Updates:
Updates will come out every week BUT once a week.
This gives people a set time to go and play the update every 
Saturday. Updates will be worked on from the start of the week
to the end of the week. Any ideas sent to me will be put off to
the next week unless its small add-on or its a fix. This new
updates has a few fixes mainly achievement fixes.

Obscure Realm: Haven't said that in a while
"Oh boy" an old friend once told me when I first told him I
wanted to make games, Obscure Realm wasn't my first idea but
it was the first I released. This person was Jeremy, a good
but not so around friend anymore, this is for you Jeremy.

Obscure Realm, this first Idea put to code will be released on
Steam in early October this year. Development is being worked on
and it will be as hard, and confusing as it was before. This time
you will have a real reason to go forward in the game. The previous
GameJolt release made people love it. Tons of feedback was received,
lots of things were fixed. But this, basically a remaster, will be the best top-down game you could possibly think off. Story,
Shops, BETTER COMBAT, and everything I learned from johns.game.
This may seem like just a jumble of information but really its
just an excited yet worried me getting ready to go back to an
old project. The game was already voted YES back in early February.
I have provided a link to the Greenlight Page, and the GameJolt page.

A Challenge for you, its very simple. Beat the GameJolt version
and you get the game for free on release.
To prove this you must share a screenshot of level 63, you
will know when you get there. That's it, its that simple.
A reward will be there waiting at the end. ːSBpandaːː2015hollyːhttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27870273/6c356d9b5e0e514210ec55ab832803e54ab30bcd.png
Change-Log: Saturday Update
Change-log: 
Update: World of Hell;

Fixed: Alexa's Shop;
Fixed: How to find Brandon (A.K.A Billy);
Fixed: Sandmen not respawning;
Fixed: Position of Meds;
Fixed: Chests working;

Added: People joining Tauber;
Added: New Boss?
Added: Items in Chest;
Added: A few new Achievements;
Added: Building  System!;

Chnaged: How some Achievements look;
Changed: C.C Units to have varied Health depending on Rank;
Changed: How to earn certain Achievement;
Changed: Amount of Trees, Rocks, and Shrubs;


Links:

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=764395109

http://gamejolt.com/games/obscure-realm/179872

Twitter:

http://steamcommunity.com/groups/ctostudios

News Letter of Doom Week 1: Content Update, Easter Rhhd. Shout-outs.
notes.notes:
Today I was planning on releasing changes made to johns.game the help make the game feel more "alive".  I decided against it. My reason is that I need to work more on the top half of the map and the woods because right now there are no new features out. As always people can recommend new items to the game like guns, quest ideas, and achievements but for now nothing is new. 

Over the last two weeks I have been working none-stop to produce more and more content, perfecting certain features. Just today I was figuring out ways to add house interiors but there is currently no good way to do so that would like visually pleasing without just making the houses dots. An Easter update was going to come out containing a small Easter themed mini game but that was kind of redundant and a big waste of time because as you all know (maybe not) but I like to make things as good as they can get. 

I would like to give out a warm loving shout-out to my favorite testing squad: Acer Slasher & Kingaj22. I love what you guys are doing to help this game become amazing, so thank you and I hope more of you guys start talking about the game and what you think.

Some new things coming to the game soon will be more stuff and people to look at and discover. A new programmer may be joining the team soon as well as a pixel artist so I'm not just doing everything on my own. 

Good luck in the Wasteland and I would love to see some screenshots! ːSBpandaːː2015hollyː

Here are a few screenshots of the upcoming update: 
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27870273/c8de823fa75d5f96a4e57b0b1ff2616e508d5f31.png

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27870273/7ef77023ee4b814c032a2667e419c0bc3ce4fb44.pnghttp://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27870273/e1126bebd69914caa3599b49e74754d07828e148.png
